name: VARGINHA
source: INMET automatic station · official hourly archive
time_note: UTC days, 00:00–24:00. Hourly extrema and rainfall assigned to the preceding hour. NASA uses local solar time; midnight boundaries differ.
rain_rule: 24 valid hourly reports required per day; all calendar days required per month. Missing is not zero.
extreme_rule: Daily Tmin/Tmax use hourly reported extrema, only with all 24 hours available. Gaps remain blank.
normal_note: No 1991–2020 normal available from this shorter automatic-station record.
